name: Objective Play
strategy: Capture, contest, and maintain control of valuable battlefield positions.

commands.name: Seize the Opening
commands.effect: One unengaged friendly Unit within Short of an objective may immediately Move up to 2" toward that objective, ending legally and unengaged.

commands.name: Dig In
commands.effect: When a friendly Unit within 2" of an objective is attacked, it gains Tough 2 against that Attack. If the Attack is a Charge, also gain Brace 1 before resolving Impact.

commands.name: Deny the Ground
commands.effect: If one friendly Unit inflicts unsaved Damage with a ranged Attack against an enemy within 2" of an objective, that enemy cannot count as more than one Unit for objective control until the end of the Round.

commands.name: Supply Point
commands.effect: Choose one friendly Unit within 2" of an objective. Either Heal 2 accumulated Damage from it or remove Withdrawn from it.

commands.name: Clear the Position
commands.effect: One friendly Unit gains +2 Attacks on its next Attack this Phase against an enemy contesting an objective.

doctrineIdentity: Scenario scoring and battlefield positioning. Objective Play does not need to be particularly effective at destroying enemies, provided its commands create meaningful opportunities to score or deny Victory Points.
